affected_system: walking, cycling, and shared micromobility network
alternatives: compare eligible treated and credible untreated units for phased protected walking and cycling network expansion
estimate pre-specified overall and distributional effects of phased protected walking and cycling network expansion
pair corridor event-study with count and conflict panels with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Trips, counts, facilities, stress levels, barriers, and shared-vehicle states use documented coverage.
Observed shared-system trips do not represent all walking and cycling demand.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain pre-intervention conditions for phased protected walking and cycling network expansion.

constraints.description: The active mobility network and micromobility evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: active transportation director and shared-mobility program manager
decision_question: Did phased protected links change exposure-normalized use, conflicts, and access across groups?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The active mobility network and micromobility evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
independence_key.decision_object: phased protected walking and cycling network expansion
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for phased protected walking and cycling network expansion passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: corridor event-study with count and conflict panels
independence_key.primary_outcome: change in low-stress trips and exposure-normalized conflicts

intended_claim: A versioned evaluate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting phased protected walking and cycling network expansion, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: change in low-stress trips and exposure-normalized conflicts
distributional gap in change in low-stress trips and exposure-normalized conflicts
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not infer causal mode shift or injury reduction from selected counters or simple before-after totals.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for phased protected walking and cycling network expansion passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.

title: Evaluate protected active-mobility network expansion
transportability_risks: Topography, climate, street stress, vehicle access, pricing, and safety perceptions vary.
Platform data can exclude private bicycles, pedestrians, and non-users.
